# Studio VisualFX

> Studio VisualFX (Pvt) Ltd is a Matara-based video production studio in Sri Lanka, led by director and videographer Sasanka Dulanjana. We create cinematic wedding films, event coverage, music videos and commercial productions for clients in Matara, Colombo and across Sri Lanka, including destination weddings for couples from overseas.

- Services: Creative Wedding Films, Pre-Wedding Shoots, Event Coverage, Commercial Productions, Music Videos
- Based in: Matara, Sri Lanka (serving Colombo and the whole island)
- Experience: 7+ years, 150+ projects
- Booking: an advance payment reserves the date; final films are delivered within 8-12 weeks
- Contact: +94 77 699 6981 (phone / WhatsApp), svisualfx@gmail.com
